nom: Peace Out Salicylic Acid Sheer Acne Day Dots

segments.oily: One reviewer recommends the patches for oily or acne-prone skin, and another notes they absorbed excess oil on her face.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers with sensitive or sensitive acne-prone skin report no irritation or dryness, with one specifically praising them for calming her sensitive skin without issue.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin says the patches work really well as a spot treatment.

concerns.redness: Many reviewers report visibly reduced redness and swelling within hours to a day of use, describing pimples as looking 'less angry' or less inflamed; no dissent reported on this point.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the patches as gentle, non-drying, and non-irritating, with several noting no dryness or irritation even on sensitive skin.
concerns.spots: The large majority describe visible shrinking, flattening, or disappearance of individual spots within hours to a couple of days, including on deep or cystic pimples; one reviewer found they did not extract whiteheads as well as hoped and one found the jumbo version fell off and released pus less effectively.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report fewer or less noticeable breakouts over time, faster healing, and prevention of picking/touching, which several credit with reducing scarring or lingering marks; no dissenting reports on repeated use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer noted the patches absorbed excess oil from her skin; this is the only mention of oil control.

aspects.libelle: Strong adhesion, stays on all day/night
Jumbo/daytime version less effective and falls off
Does not dry out or irritate skin

The dots I bought were the daytime jumbo dots. They don't work as well as the acne ones they fall off easily and don't release pus as well
